svg.title: The lease number that crossed decades
svg.desc: Original editorial evidence graphic. Three separate records mention State Lease 195: a 1965 Fifth Circuit opinion concerning Stone Island water bottoms; a 1970 Louisiana Supreme Court case involving other Plaquemines water-bottom title claims and a remand; and a July 2023 state nomination excluding parts of Bohemia Tract 193 already covered by State Leases 195 and 22099. A shared lease number does not establish that the litigated lands were Bohemia Tract 193 or Eusan Tract 78. 1965 opinion says February 28, 1928; 1970 opinion says February 20, 1928. Original instrument has not been retrieved.
svg.metadata: Creator: Final Vestige Studios; date: 2026-11-17; copyright: © 2026 Final Vestige Studios. Original source-based schematic, not an archive scan or title survey. Sources: https://law.justia.com/cases/federal/appellate-courts/F2/346/43/445482/ ; https://law.justia.com/cases/louisiana/supreme-court/1970/255-la-857-0.html ; https://www.denr.louisiana.gov/assets/OMR/NOP_tracts/2023/45656-45659.pdf . Cite each source separately for its own parcel and judicial outcome.
